item.title: GDAN Tumor Molecular Pathology
item.description:
The Genomic Data Analysis Network (GDAN) Tumor Molecular Pathology (TMP) project developed machine-learning models that assign TCGA-defined molecular subtype labels to cancer samples from other studies and clinical trials. The study trained five modeling approaches on 8,791 TCGA tumors spanning 106 subtypes across 26 cancer cohorts, and validated selected classifiers using external datasets.

The TMP model repository provides containerized models for gene expression, DNA methylation, miRNA, somatic mutation, and copy-number data, along with tools and instructions for preparing data and running predictions. Read the Cancer Cell paper for the study and its results.

item.title: MC3
item.description:
The TCGA PanCancer Atlas MC3 project re-called mutations across TCGA exome data to provide a more uniform resource for cross-cancer analysis. Earlier TCGA studies used different calling methods over time and across centers, making direct comparisons difficult.

MC3 applied multiple mutation-calling algorithms to standardized, realigned data and used automated filters to produce a harmonized call set. Before using the data, consult its documentation for processing details, filters, caveats, and recommended practices.
